benchmark: LOCAL catch-up idle duty (2-vCPU floor surrogate)
system_commit: 0.82: 777f6756c3dd7f9976a45b4040d1f6697f0f5474; 1.0: 7f82e84b25d00fe8a5abcb38590c2b129abe4a8f. This PR applies the measured multiplier to current main; unrelated intervening changes were not remeasured.
judge: No model judge; deterministic CPU sampling and coverage-pair gates in bench/instruments/local_catchup at the harness commits.
reader: No answering model; one background FastEmbed process per cell.
retrieval_config: Synthetic 250000-row mixed/short stores, upgrade/empty coverage pairs; embeddings enabled explicitly, fastembed BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, one ORT intra-op thread, float32, conversational chunks, embedding_max_batch_items=1000; idle multiplier 1.0 vs 0.82; at least two hours per cell with backlog throughout. No retrieval/recall latency claim.
dataset_exposure: Synthetic corpus; no benchmark gold answers or customer data.
breakdown: Eight per-cell summaries (four at 1.0, four at 0.82), CPU mean/p95 and labeled coverage projections: https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/blob/5147f75305b5d262dcb30a13a194f2c89e4a109c/bench/scoreboard/evidence/1586-idle-duty-probe-2026-10-23.json
variance: One run per multiplier/shape, two baseline cells per run; no repeats, confidence intervals or A/A noise estimate.
failclose: No cells excluded. The 1.0 mixed upgrade cell fails the coverage projection bar; CPU sampling is reported for every cell. Catch-up stops at the two-hour measurement bound with incomplete coverage.
caveats: Claim class: advisory; floor-surrogate only. The scoreboard value is measured CPU, never projected completion time.
At 0.82, maximum per-cell mean CPU 0.5505486880915895 and p95 rolling-60s CPU 0.6336526290227705 are under the 0.6/0.75-core bars.
Coverage projections are disclosed in the evidence only; they do not establish completed 72-hour catch-up. Mixed margin is about 6%; the full floor rerun is the judge.
Fault-finding yield: 1.0 fails one mixed coverage cell; 0.82 passes the probe coverage/CPU bars. No full-floor, recall-latency, customer-box or Mac 24-hour proof.
